jobs.name: Заброшенная деревня
jobs.layout: Left-aligned vertical menu occupying the left quarter. Main view is an atmospheric abandoned Eastern European village in cool overcast morning: ruined wood houses, wet dirt road, rusty car, overgrown grass, large fungal growths in distance. Spacious scene with subtle mist, nobody posing for a portrait.
jobs.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE landscape 16:9 main menu screenshot for our original top-down 2D pixel-art cooperative fungal-apocalypse survival desktop game. Input image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: use its approved A field UI dark charcoal translucent panels, muted olive button highlights, warm off-white text, fine square pixel borders. Do not reproduce gameplay HUD, minimap, teammate list or hotbar from the reference. Main menu composition A: Left-aligned vertical menu occupying the left quarter. Main view is an atmospheric abandoned Eastern European village in cool overcast morning: ruined wood houses, wet dirt road, rusty car, overgrown grass, large fungal growths in distance. Spacious scene with subtle mist, nobody posing for a portrait. Consistent crisp pixel art in both background and menu with visible square pixels, closest-neighbor edges, limited muted palette, no photorealism, no 3D render, no isometric camera; use overhead/top-down scene where appropriate. Exact temporary title: "PIXEL APOCALYPSE". Exact Russian menu labels in this order: "ПРОДОЛЖИТЬ", "СОЗДАТЬ МИР", "ПОДКЛЮЧИТЬСЯ", "НАСТРОЙКИ", "ВЫХОД". Five large readable buttons, olive highlight on СОЗДАТЬ МИР, subtle disabled grey ПРОДОЛЖИТЬ. Small lower-corner text "КООПЕРАТИВ 2–6 ИГРОКОВ". No other navigation, no store, no battle pass, no task list, no browser or device frame. No comparison board or labels A/B/C inside screenshot. Main focus is usable polished main-menu interface with atmospheric scene. Preserve approved field-interface look across all three variants.
